verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तच्छ्रुत्वा विष्णुगदितं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः। उवाच परमं वाक्यं हितं सर्वदिवौकसाम्॥१॥
नास्ति किञ्चिद्भयं विष्णो सुराणामसुरान्तक। येषां भवानभयदः कर्णधारो रणे रणे॥२॥
verses.english: All those kings with an effulgence akin to that of great sages are the believers of Almighty endeavouring to bring back the golden age, कृत युगं…
verses.bhavadeepa: एकाधिकेऽथ पञ्चाशेऽध्याये विष्णोर्निरूप्यते। भूभारहरणार्थाय ब्रह्मप्रार्थनमद्भुतम्॥१॥ तच्छ्रुत्वेति॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: शक्रे जयति देवेशे त्वयि चासुरसूदने। धर्मे प्रयतमानानां मानवानां कुतो भयम्॥३॥
verses.english: On hearing the words of viShNu, then ब्रह्म the grandparent of all, gave vent to words fraught with the well-being of gods… “Oh annihilator of demons, there is no fear for gods from असुरा-s, because you are protecting gods, from battle to battle, like a many sided weapon – कर्ण धार…
verses.bhavadeepa: कर्णौ नौकापरिवर्तकरो महान् दण्डः तस्य धारः कर्णधारस्तद्वदिति लुप्तोपमा॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: सत्ये धर्मे च निरतान्मानवान्विगतज्वरान्। नाकाले धर्मिणो मृत्युः शक्नोति प्रसमीक्षितुम्॥४॥
verses.english: Wending righteous ways many of these kings are enhancing their territories. Amongst men the three other social orders are following brAhmaNa-s…

verses.sanskrit: मानवानां च पतयः पार्थिवाश्च परस्परम्। षड्भागमुपभुञ्जाना न भयं कुर्वते मिथः॥५॥
verses.english: Without creating disturbance amongst their subjects, ministers adoring them well, four divisions of army, footsoldiers, cavalry, chariot-fleet, elephant division protecting tem, those kings are implementing the six-fold political manoeuvring…

verses.sanskrit: ते प्रजानां शुभकराः करदैरवगर्हिताः। सुकरैर्विप्रयुक्तर्थाः कोशमापूरयन्त्युत॥६॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the fifty-first chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the dialog between viShNu and gods regarding the lessening of burden of mother earth.

verses.sanskrit: स्फीताञ्जनपदान्सर्वान्पालयन्तः क्षमापराः। अतीक्ष्णदण्डांश्चतुरो वर्णाञ्जुगुपुरञ्जसा॥७॥
verses.english: On undergoing the ceremony of initiation and on studying Vedas they propitiate great saints with chastity in thought, words and deeds… with offertories and oblations they variously beatify their ancestral manes –in श्राद्ध rituals…
verses.bhavadeepa: सुकरैर्यथोचितैः करग्रहैः विशेषेण प्रयुक्तार्थाः बहुकरग्रहो हि राजा प्रजा उद्वासयन्न कोशवृद्धिकरो भवति एते तु न तथासन्नित्यर्थः॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: नोद्वेजनीया भूतानां सचिवैः साधुपूजिताः। चतुरङ्गबलैर्गुप्ताः षड्गुणानुपभुञ्जते॥८॥
verses.english: We on our part heard her history, and you too are aware of it… as such we wished to discuss this with you as to how her burden can be offloaded…

verses.sanskrit: धनुर्वेदपराः सर्वे सर्वे वेदेषु निष्ठिताः। यजन्ते च यथाकालं यज्ञैर्विपुलदक्षिणैः॥९॥
verses.english: All are well-versed in the science of archery, observant of the Vedic rites and all worship gods with vedic-rituals that are accompanied with profuse gifts…
verses.bhavadeepa: नोद्वेजनीयाः अनुद्वेजकाः सन्तः षड्गुणान् नीतिशास्त्रोक्तान् सन्धिविग्रहयनासनद्वैधीभावसमाश्रयाख्यान् उपभुञ्जते सेवन्ते॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: वेदानधीत्य दीक्षाभिर्महर्षीन्ब्रह्मचर्यया। श्राद्धैश्च मेध्यैः शतशस्तर्पयन्ति पितामहान्॥१०॥
verses.english: On undergoing the ceremony of initiation and on studying Vedas they propitiate great saints with chastity in thought, words and deeds… with offertories and oblations they variously beatify their ancestral manes –in श्राद्ध rituals…

verses.sanskrit: नैषामविदितं किञ्चित्त्रिविधं भुवि दृश्यते। वैदिकं लौकिकं चैव धर्मशास्त्रोक्तमेव च॥११॥
verses.english: 'This earth is the goal of the pious and none else. Virtue is the most cxceilent object they should endeavour to secure, wherefore, to relieve the earth of her burden it is meet to destroy the kings, for they are a very froward generation…
verses.bhavadeepa: वेदानधीत्य महर्षीन्दीक्षाभिर्नियमग्रहणैः चर्यया यज्ञक्रियया च ब्रह्म हिरण्यगर्भाख्यं सर्वदेवतामयं तर्पयन्ति॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: ते परावरदिष्टार्थ महर्षिसमतेजसः। भूयः कृतयुगं कर्तुमुत्सहन्ते नराधिपाः॥१२॥
verses.english: The sun with his rays in a natural direction is moving in his two solstitial paths, and the fire being regularly propitiated with various fire-oblations is aromatised…

verses.sanskrit: तेषामेव प्रभावेण शिवं वर्षति वासवः। यथार्थं च ववुर्वाता विरजस्का दिशो दश॥१३॥
verses.english: Owing to their congenial nature indra is showering rains seasonably, and wind is whiffing dustless winds everywhere, at need…
verses.bhavadeepa: परे अवरे च ब्रह्मणि दृष्टार्था जातप्रत्ययाः कृतयुगं पापलेशेनाप्यननुविद्धं कृत्स्नधर्मम्॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: निरुत्पाता च वसुधा सुप्रचाराश्च खे ग्रहाः। चन्द्रमाश्च सनक्षत्रः सौम्यं चरति योगतः॥१४॥
verses.english: Earth is devoid of upheavals, planets are gliding smoothly on the sky, and the moon with his constellations is orbiting sedulously…

verses.sanskrit: अनुलोमकरः सूर्यस्त्वयने द्वे चचार ह। हव्यैश्च विविधैस्तृप्तः शुभगन्धो हुताशनः॥१५॥
verses.english: The sun with his rays in a natural direction is moving in his two solstitial paths, and the fire being regularly propitiated with various fire-oblations is aromatised…

verses.sanskrit: एवं सम्यक्प्रवृत्तेषु विवृद्धेषु मखादिषु। तर्पयत्सु महीं कृत्स्नां नृणां कालभयं कुतः॥१६॥
verses.english: When world is functional where men are the instruments of righteousness, we have to think of a system with which dharma does not suffer deterioration at the hands of some wrongdoers…

verses.sanskrit: तेषां ज्वलितकीर्तीनामन्योन्यवशवर्तिनाम्। राज्ञां बलैर्बलवतां पीड्यते वसुधातलम्॥१७॥
verses.english: The earth is labouring under the body, energy, strength, population and the extensive territories of the kshatriya kings…

verses.sanskrit: सेयं भारपरिश्रान्ता पीड्यमाना नराधिपैः। पृथिवी समनुप्राप्ता नौरिवासन्नविप्लवा॥१८॥
युगान्तसदृशै रूपैः शैलोच्चलितबन्धना। जलोत्पीडाकुला स्वेदं धारयन्ती मुहुर्मुहुः॥१९॥
verses.english: Each and every city is ruled by a king surrounded with millions of soldiers; that too with a mightier-than-thou concept; hundreds and thousands of villages are coming up compounded with those many provinces, and many rulers; and this inflation is covering the earth without an elbow-room…
verses.bhavadeepa: नराधिपैः रूपैः स्वशरीरैः युगान्तो वह्निस्तत्सदृशैः पीडयमानेत्यन्वयः। आसन्नविप्लवा उपस्थितविनाशा॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियाणां वपुर्भिश्च तेजसा च बलेन च। नृणां च राष्ट्रैर्विस्तीर्णैः श्राम्यतीव वसुन्धरा॥२०॥
verses.english: The earth is labouring under the body, energy, strength, population and the extensive territories of the kshatriya kings…
verses.bhavadeepa: शैलोच्चलितबन्धना यथा समुद्रे लोहमयैर्लाङ्गलैर्निरुद्धा सती महताऽपि वायुना न चाल्यते तद्वत्पृथिवी पर्वतैर्जलमध्ये धृताऽस्ति इदानीं शैलरूपाणि उच्चलितानि बन्धनानि यस्यास्तथाविधाऽभूत्। अत एव जलस्य उत्पीडा उपर्यागमनेन या पीडा तया आकुला। स्वेदम् आर्द्रताम्॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: पुरे पुरे नरपतिः कोटिसङ्ख्यैर्बलैर्वृतः। राष्ट्रे राष्ट्रे च बहवो ग्रामाः शतसहस्रशः॥२१॥
verses.english: This earth, the land of human actions, has been greatly assailed. It behoves thee to do that by which the eternal earth, the stay of the universe, may not suffer deterioration…

verses.sanskrit: भूमिपानां सहस्रैश्च तेषां च बलिनां बलैः। ग्रामायुताढ्यै राष्ट्रैश्च भूमिर्निर्विवरा कृता॥२२॥
verses.english: Each and every city is ruled by a king surrounded with millions of soldiers; that too with a mightier-than-thou concept; hundreds and thousands of villages are coming up compounded with those many provinces, and many rulers; and this inflation is covering the earth without an elbow-room…

verses.sanskrit: सेयं निरामयं कृत्वा निश्चेष्टा कालमग्रतः। प्राप्ता ममालयं विष्णो भवांश्चास्याः परा गतिः॥२३॥
verses.english: Oppressed by a series of kings the earth has become evidently exhausted. Renouncing her natural forbearance and dynamism she has become static…

verses.sanskrit: कर्मभूमिर्मनुष्याणां भूमिरेषा व्यथां गता। यथा न सीदेत्तत्कार्यं जगत्येषा हि शाश्वती॥२४॥
verses.english: We on our part heard her history, and you too are aware of it… as such we wished to discuss this with you as to how her burden can be offloaded…
verses.bhavadeepa: सेयं भूमिर्निरामयं कालम् अग्रतः कृत्वा निश्चेष्टा सती ममालयं प्राप्तेत्यन्वयः। यत्र आमयोऽपि प्रजानां नास्ति कुतो मृत्युस्तं कालं निमित्तीकृत्य तत्कृतं बहुभारत्वं प्राप्य वहनासमर्था श्रान्तवाहसदृशी सतीत्यर्थः॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit: अस्या हि पीडने दोषो महान्स्यान्मधुसूदन। क्रियालोपश्च लोकानां पीडितं च जगद्भवेत्॥२५॥
verses.english: Oppressing her is a great iniquity, ऒ म्धुसूदन; any inaction in preventing it will further deteriorate the situation…
verses.bhavadeepa: न सीदेत् लोष्टवद्बहुभारेण न विशीर्येत। जगती जगदाधारभूता॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: श्राम्यते व्यक्तमेवेयं पार्थिवौघप्रपीडिता। सहजां या क्षमां त्यक्त्वा चलत्वमचला गता॥२६॥
verses.english: All are biding by truthful words, all social orders are observing their respective duties, all the brAhmaNa-s are well-read in Vedas and all other men are devoted to brAhmaNa-s…

verses.sanskrit: तदस्याः श्रुतवन्तः स्म तच्चापि भवता श्रुतम्। भारावतरणार्थं हि मन्त्रयाम सह त्वया॥२७॥
verses.english: When world is functional where men are the instruments of righteousness, we have to think of a system with which dharma does not suffer deterioration at the hands of some wrongdoers…

verses.sanskrit: सत्पथे हि स्थिताः सर्वे राजानो राष्ट्रवर्धनाः। नराणां च त्रयो वर्णा ब्राह्मणाननुयायिनः॥२८॥
सर्वं सत्यपरं वाक्यं वर्णा धर्मपरास्तथा। सर्वे वेदपरा विप्राः सर्वे विप्रपरा नराः॥२९॥
verses.english: Therefore, O great one, come with us to hold a consultation… with the earth before us let us go to the summit of the mount…

verses.sanskrit: एवं जगति वर्तन्ते मनुष्या धर्मकारणात्। यथा धर्मवधो न स्यात्तथा मन्त्रः प्रवर्त्यताम्॥३०॥
verses.english: Having said this much, O foremost of kings janamejaya, the self-controlled grandparent of great effulgence, brahma, paused and awaited along with the earth for the consent of viShNu…

verses.sanskrit: सतां गतिरियं नान्या धर्मश्चास्याः सुसाधनम्। राज्ञां चैव वधः कार्यो धरण्या भारनिर्णये॥३१॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the fifty-first chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the dialog between viShNu and gods regarding the lessening of burden of mother earth.

verses.sanskrit: तदागच्छ महाभाग सह वै मन्त्रकारणात्। व्रजामो मेरुशिखरं पुरस्कृत्य वसुन्धराम्॥३२॥
verses.english: Therefore, O great one, come with us to hold a consultation… with the earth before us let us go to the summit of the mount…

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः। पृथिव्या सह विश्वात्मा विरराम महाद्युतिः॥३३॥
